mechanism: Naloxone antagonizes opioid receptors while oxybutynin has anticholinergic properties; combined CNS depression and potential reduced efficacy if oxybutynin is used concurrently with opioids being reversed by naloxone.
action: Monitor for reduced therapeutic effect of oxybutynin and assess for CNS depression; use with caution in patients requiring both opioid reversal and anticholinergic therapy.
